portfolio_v3.confidence_derivation: mean selected-active p_beat_spy_pct; 0.5 when all slots fall back to SPY
portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Cross-sectional divergence is large, although the aggregate dispersion statistic is missing and Ethereum is an extreme outlier. Expanding activity and positive real spending argue against indiscriminate recession positioning, while elevated prices, a recent Fed hike and weak employment constrain broad risk taking. Selective pullback reversals are more credible than buying every laggard; energy has independent supply support. The October inflation releases, FOMC meeting and November 6 employment report can materially change leadership before the exit.

portfolio_rationale: Energy ranks first on an independent near-term supply catalyst, but its supported-continuation classification makes it ineligible under the fixed reversal rule.
